<Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk">

<PropertyGroup>
    <Description>This is the Microsoft Azure Key Vault Administration client library</Description>
    <AssemblyTitle>Microsoft Azure.Security.KeyVault.Administration client library</AssemblyTitle>
    <Version>4.9.0-beta.4</Version>
    <!--The ApiCompatVersion is managed automatically and should not generally be modified manually.-->
    <ApiCompatVersion>4.8.0</ApiCompatVersion>
    <PackageTags>Microsoft Azure Key Vault Administration;$(PackageCommonTags)</PackageTags>
    <DisableEnhancedAnalysis>true</DisableEnhancedAnalysis>
    <TargetFrameworks>$(RequiredTargetFrameworks)</TargetFrameworks>
    <IncludeOperationsSharedSource>true</IncludeOperationsSharedSource>
    <AotCompatOptOut>true</AotCompatOptOut>
  </PropertyGroup>

  <ItemGroup>
    <PackageReference Include="Azure.Core" />
  </ItemGroup>

  <ItemGroup>
    <!-- Include just the few items we need from Azure.Security.KeyVault.Shared -->
    <Compile Include="$(MSBuildThisFileDirectory)\..\..\Azure.Security.KeyVault.Shared\src\ChallengeBasedAuthenticationPolicy.cs" />
    <Compile Include="$(MSBuildThisFileDirectory)\..\..\Azure.Security.KeyVault.Shared\src\TenantTokenBindingCredential.cs" />
    <Compile Include="$(MSBuildThisFileDirectory)\..\..\Azure.Security.KeyVault.Shared\src\ClientOptionsExtensions.cs" />
    <Compile Include="$(MSBuildThisFileDirectory)\..\..\Azure.Security.KeyVault.Shared\src\IJsonSerializable.cs" />
  </ItemGroup>

  <ItemGroup>
    <Compile Include="$(AzureCoreSharedSources)ArrayBufferWriter.cs" LinkBase="Shared\Core" />
    <Compile Include="$(AzureCoreSharedSources)AzureEventSource.cs" LinkBase="Shared\Core" />
    <Compile Include="$(AzureCoreSharedSources)AuthorizationChallengeParser.cs" LinkBase="Shared\Core" />
    <Compile Include="$(AzureCoreSharedSources)AzureResourceProviderNamespaceAttribute.cs" LinkBase="Shared\Core" />

  </ItemGroup>

</Project>

proposals.subtype: Expose typed backup response headers
proposals.explanation: The response wrapper exposes nullable integer Retry-After and string Azure-AsyncOperation values through TryGetValue, returning null when lookup fails. Its consumers and any polling/delay algorithm are absent.

proposals.handwrittenRationale: The complete source is outside Generated and implements the getters explicitly under the .NET source rule.

proposals.subtype: Expose typed selective-restore response headers

Its location outside Generated alone, under a guideline explicitly proposed for confirmation, does not establish this as handwritten rather than generated header plumbing; no poller is shown.

The full-restore header accessors at lines 12-20 have the same boilerplate response-wrapper structure as the other header files; origin is unknown and no custom polling or distinct handwritten change is visible. A non-Generated path is a proposed, not confirmed, provenance rule.

The selective-restore header accessors at lines 12-20 mirror the other two internal wrappers. Unknown origin and no explicit customization signal leave ordinary generated header projection plausible; the code does not implement polling.

The non-Generated public options class explicitly creates a Guid in its one-argument constructor, delegates to the second constructor, stores the supplied scope and identity, and initializes two mutable collections (lines 20-67). No global-scope substitution is claimed in these constructors.

The handwritten options method explicitly constructs the internal request-parameter model, copies permission and scope entries into nested collections and returns a wrapper (lines 73-93); it does not claim to implement JSON encoding or deep copying.

The CodeGenType attribute on the non-Generated public client explicitly associates it with KeyVaultAccessControlRestClient (lines 19-20); client mapping, not model replacement, is the supported scope of this proposal.

The source supports constructor-level challenge-policy wiring, not a handwritten implementation of the imported ChallengeBasedAuthenticationPolicy. Narrowed the subtype, explanation, pattern and generator-addressability judgment to the visible client construction and option.

The policy implementation and resulting challenge handling are not supplied.
